content.text: Was looking at some free agents last night and just want to check. Do you have anything cooking on the minor league front?
No not re██ly at this time. Not re██ly sure if we will do anything.
If anything comes up, I will try if I can to give you a heads up
I'm not looking for a scoop, just figured I'd ask. John told me to try to think like you and you've been big on depth. Still some vets out there unsigned.
